description: Use this when someone asks when a Spanish Modelo 210 (non-resident income tax) is due for a home in Spain: not let, let all year, let part of the year, or sold. Returns each return's filing window, the direct debit's last day, whether the window is open today, what filing late costs, and the sources (Orden HAC/623/2026 changed the windows from tax year 2026).

language.description: Language of the CasitaTax pages linked in the answer: da, de, en, es, fr, nl, no, fi or sv. Default en.

sale_date.description: For sold: the day of the sale (the deed), YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, the rule is given without dates.

situation.description: not_rented: the home wasn't let (own use, empty); rented: let all year; rented_part_of_year: let some of the year; sold: the home was sold.

name: modelo_210_deadlines
title: Modelo 210 deadlines
